_comment: Blog posts, newest first (a pinned post stays on top). Never add an invented post. Each post: { "id": "slug", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "title": "...", "author": "...", "summary": "...", "url": "/blog/#slug", "pinned": true|false, "body": ["paragraph", ...] }. A post with a body is shown in full on the Blog page. A post with a body ends with a 'Share your experience' link to the contact section and takes reader comments (assets/js/comments.js + comments-api/index.php on the GoDaddy host; the list of posts that take comments is generated into comments-api/posts.json).

posts.title: Who judges whether Rosie's rules work?
posts.author: Noal
posts.summary: Whether Rosie follows her rules can be checked today. Whether the rules are worth having shows up in your own records. Your experience is the test.
body: Who judges whether a trading rule works? Not me, and not Rosie. Whether she follows the rules exactly can be checked today. Whether the rules are worth having only shows up over many trades, in real markets, in your own records. That's where you come in. Tell us what you saw: a stop that saved you, a rule that felt too tight, a day you didn't have to watch. Your experience is the test.
